name: Los Angeles County, CA
findings: Los Angeles County has 36,252 nonprofit organizations. 11,836 of them (33%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 9,210 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (22% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Los Angeles County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
